title: Lab Rift
summary: A laboratory escape run collecting shards before the gate opens.
instructions: Move with arrows or WASD. Collect every shard, then escape through the open gate.

overlay.startCopy: A small top-down room run. Sweep the chamber, dodge the sentries, and unlock the exit with every shard.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Enter Rift in the center overlay.
Move with Arrow Keys or WASD.
Collect every shard before leaving the room.
Avoid the sentries while you route to the gate.
tips: Map the room first, then collect the closest shard.
The exit opens after every shard is taken.

onboarding.title: Lab Setup
startSteps: Open Help to learn the movement keys.
Press Enter Rift to enter the chamber.
Take the first shard and then route toward the exit path.
onboarding.firstGoal: Collect the first shard and start clearing the room.
